evals.prompt: I want to set up my product marketing context. We're a B2B SaaS company that sells a customer feedback platform to product teams.
evals.expected_output: Should check if .agents/product-marketing-context.md already exists. Should offer two options: auto-draft from codebase or start from scratch. Should create the file at .agents/product-marketing-context.md when complete.
assertions: Offers two options: auto-draft or start from scratch

evals.prompt: Can you auto-draft our product marketing context from our existing codebase and marketing materials?
evals.expected_output: Should scan the codebase, draft all sections, flag sections needing manual input, and present draft for review before saving.
assertions: Scans codebase for existing marketing materials
Presents draft for review before saving
